card.name: The "most" in "The most common" sentences
card.fires_on: The word "most" right after a sentence-starting "The" in safety summaries, as in "The most frequent/common ..." naming the leading event or infection. It also fires weakly on a few other sentence-opening or emphasis words such as "Not", "NOT" and "the".

modes.label: The most common/frequent
modes.description: "most" opens a sentence that names the leading adverse event, infection or malignancy.

modes.label: Stray emphasis or negation words
modes.description: A capitalized or sentence-initial "Not", "NOT" or "the" in table or heading text.
